title: Sheesh, so frustrating
content: I had my usual frustration mall dream again last night. It was so frustrating, I’m always looking for a certain location or person there and can never find what I need in my purse to aid me. Maybe can’t find my car keys or can’t find my phone. I’ve been playing with my doll collection IRL (I’m an adult) and images of dolls and doll clothes kept appearing sporadically and it was my just so confusing. Does this ever end? I’m over 70.
